## Current Phase
**Active development.** `apps/web` (Next.js 14) is scaffolded with Ignite UI components. `apps/api` (NestJS) and `packages/shared` are now scaffolded as stubs — all 6 domain modules exist with service/controller/repository skeletons. Docker Compose provides Postgres 16 + Redis 7.

## Database Schema (Kysely tables in database.types.ts)

| Table | Domain | Key Fields |
|-------|--------|-----------|
| users | auth | id, email, email_verified, password_hash, oauth_provider, oauth_sub |
| refresh_tokens | auth | id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at |
| user_profiles | users | user_id, display_name, fitness_goal, activity_level, height_cm |
| body_metrics | users | id, user_id, logged_at, weight_kg, body_fat_pct |
| exercises | workouts | id, slug, name, muscle_groups[], equipment, movement_type |
| training_plans | workouts | id, user_id, weeks_total, days_per_week, is_active |
| training_days | workouts | id, plan_id, day_number, name, focus[] |
| training_day_exercises | workouts | id, training_day_id, exercise_id, sets_prescribed, reps_min, reps_max |
| workout_sessions | workouts | id, user_id, training_day_id, checked_in_at, checked_out_at, total_volume_kg |
| set_logs | workouts | id, session_id, exercise_id, set_number, reps, weight_kg, is_pr |
| personal_records | workouts | id, user_id, exercise_id, pr_type, value |
| cardio_logs | workouts | id, session_id, equipment_type, duration_minutes, source |
| nutrition_targets | nutrition | user_id, calories, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g |
| meal_logs | nutrition | id, user_id, meal_type, description, calories, protein_g |
| conversations | ai-coach | id, user_id, context_type, last_message_at |
| messages | ai-coach | id, conversation_id, role, content, tokens_used |
| media | media | id, user_id, storage_key, cdn_url, purpose, ocr_status |

## ADR Decisions Reference

| ADR | Decision | Key Constraint |
|-----|----------|----------------|
| ADR-001 | Modular monolith (NestJS) | 6 bounded domains, EventEmitter2, extract-ready |
| ADR-002 | Next.js 14 App Router | PWA, RSC, streaming Suspense for AI, TypeScript |
| ADR-003 | PostgreSQL 16 + Redis 7 | Kysely ORM, pgvector future, BullMQ queues |
| ADR-004 | Layered prompt caching | 5-layer context, ~8000 tokens/req, 90% token reduction |
| ADR-005 | EventEmitter2 (intra-domain) | Typed event contracts in packages/shared/src/events/ |
| ADR-006 | PWA over React Native | next-pwa + Workbox, Play Store via TWA |
